title: Feelings
description: Say how you feel and respond when someone else does.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki aaj khushi?
options: Ha, ami khub khushi.
Na, ami cha khabo.
Ha, ami Kolkata thaki.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ami khub khushi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am very happy.

questions.sentence: Aaj amar mon kharap.
options: I feel sad today.
I feel great today.
I am busy today.
questions.correctAnswer: I feel sad today.

questions.sentence: Tomar mon kharap kano?
options: Amar bondhu chole gyache.
Ami kal Kolkata jabo.
Ha, ami khub bhalo achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar bondhu chole gyache.
questions.translatedSentence: My friend has gone away.

questions.sentence: Ami aaj khub khushi.
options: I am very happy today.
I am very sad today.
I am very tired today.
questions.correctAnswer: I am very happy today.

questions.sentence: Amar khub mon kharap lagche.
options: Kano, ki hoyeche?
Tomar naam ki?
Ami ekhon bhaat khabo.
questions.correctAnswer: Kano, ki hoyeche?
questions.translatedSentence: Why, what happened?

questions.sentence: Se aaj khub khushi.
options: He is very happy today.
He is very sad today.
He is at home today.
questions.correctAnswer: He is very happy today.

questions.sentence: Ami aaj khub bhalo achi.
options: Bah, khub bhalo!
Ish, kharap khobor.
Na, ami jani na.
questions.correctAnswer: Bah, khub bhalo!
questions.translatedSentence: Oh, that is great!

questions.sentence: Amar bondhur mon kharap.
options: My friend is sad.
My friend is happy.
My friend is at home.
questions.correctAnswer: My friend is sad.

questions.sentence: Tomar ki mon kharap?
options: Ha, ektu mon kharap.
Ha, ami cha khete bhalobashi.
Na, ami Kolkata jabo.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ektu mon kharap.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am a little sad.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki khub klanto?
options: Ha, ami khub klanto.
Ha, ami khub khushi.
Na, ami cha khai na.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ami khub klanto.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I am very tired.

questions.sentence: Ami sara din kaj kore khub klanto.
options: I worked all day and I am very tired.
I worked all day and I am very happy.
I stayed at home all day and I am bored.
questions.correctAnswer: I worked all day and I am very tired.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki amar upor rege acho?
options: Na, ami rege nei.
Ha, ami khub klanto.
Na, ami ekhon bari jabo.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, ami rege nei.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I am not angry.

questions.sentence: Amar bhai amar upor khub rege ache.
options: My brother is very angry with me.
My brother is very happy with me.
My brother is very tired today.
questions.correctAnswer: My brother is very angry with me.

questions.sentence: Ekhane eto ondhokar, amar bhoy korche.
options: Bhoy peo na, ami achi.
Ha, ami khub khushi.
Na, ami alo jalate jani na.
questions.correctAnswer: Bhoy peo na, ami achi.
questions.translatedSentence: Do not be scared, I am here.

questions.sentence: Ami raate ekla thakte bhoy pai.
options: I am scared to stay alone at night.
I am happy to stay alone at night.
I do not like going out at night.
questions.correctAnswer: I am scared to stay alone at night.

questions.sentence: Tumi eto chup kore acho kano?
options: Amar kichhu bhalo lagche na.
Ami Kolkata theke esechi.
Ha, cha ta khub bhalo.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar kichhu bhalo lagche na.
questions.translatedSentence: I do not feel like doing anything.

questions.sentence: Barite boshe boshe amar khub ekghyeye lagche.
options: Sitting at home all the time is making me really bored.
Sitting at home all the time is making me really happy.
Working at home all the time is making me really tired.
questions.correctAnswer: Sitting at home all the time is making me really bored.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki bhoy pele?
options: Ha, ami ektu bhoy pelam.
Na, ami khub rege achi.
Na, ami kichhu jani na.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ami ektu bhoy pelam.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I got a little scared.

questions.sentence: Apni kemon achen?
options: Ami bhalo achi, dhonnobad.
Apnar naam ki?
Ami cha khete bhalobashi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami bhalo achi, dhonnobad.
questions.translatedSentence: I am well, thank you.

questions.sentence: Apnar shorir ekhon kemon ache?
options: How are you feeling now?
Where are you going now?
What are you doing now?
questions.correctAnswer: How are you feeling now?

questions.sentence: Tomar ki mon kharap, na ki shudhu klanto?
options: Shudhu klanto, ar kichhu na.
Ha, ami khub rege achi.
Na, ami bhoy pai na.
questions.correctAnswer: Shudhu klanto, ar kichhu na.
questions.translatedSentence: Just tired, nothing else.

questions.sentence: Aaj apnake ektu mon mora lagche.
options: You look a little down today.
You look a little tired today.
You look very happy today.
questions.correctAnswer: You look a little down today.

questions.sentence: Ki holo, tomake eto chintito lagche kano?
options: Kalke amar porikkha, tai chinta hochche.
Ha, ami kal Howrah jabo.
Amar bari ekhan theke onek dure.
questions.correctAnswer: Kalke amar porikkha, tai chinta hochche.
questions.translatedSentence: I have an exam tomorrow, so I am worried.

questions.sentence: Apni ki thik achen, na ki daktar dakbo?
options: Are you all right, or should I call a doctor?
Are you ready, or should I wait outside?
Are you coming, or should I go alone?
questions.correctAnswer: Are you all right, or should I call a doctor?

questions.sentence: Tumi ekhon kemon bodh korcho?
options: Ager theke onek bhalo lagche.
Ami kal theke asbo.
Amar bari Kolkatay.
questions.correctAnswer: Ager theke onek bhalo lagche.
questions.translatedSentence: I feel much better than before.

questions.sentence: Tomar kichhu darkar hole amake bolo.
options: Tell me if you need anything.
Tell me when you reach home.
Ask me if you do not know the way.
questions.correctAnswer: Tell me if you need anything.

questions.sentence: Apnar mon ki ekhono kharap?
options: Na, ekhon ar kharap lagche na.
Ha, ami kal office jabo.
Na, ami cha khai na.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, ekhon ar kharap lagche na.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I do not feel bad any more.

questions.sentence: Amar khub chinta hochche, ki hobe jani na.
options: Chinta koro na, sob thik hoye jabe.
Ha, ami o kichhu jani na.
Tahole ami ekhon bari jai.
questions.correctAnswer: Chinta koro na, sob thik hoye jabe.
questions.translatedSentence: Do not worry, everything will be fine.

questions.sentence: Mon kharap koro na, ami tomar pashe achi.
options: Do not be sad, I am here beside you.
Do not be angry, I will call you later.
Do not go alone, I will come with you.
questions.correctAnswer: Do not be sad, I am here beside you.

questions.sentence: Mone hochche ami porikkhay bhalo korte parbo na.
options: Tumi niscoi parbe, ektu cheshta koro.
Tahole tumi porikkha diyo na.
Ami o eibar kichhu porini.
questions.correctAnswer: Tumi niscoi parbe, ektu cheshta koro.
questions.translatedSentence: You will definitely manage it, just try a little.

questions.sentence: Eto bhebo na, kalke sob thik hoye jabe.
options: Do not think so much, everything will be fine tomorrow.
Do not come so late, everything will be closed tomorrow.
Do not worry, I will finish all the work tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: Do not think so much, everything will be fine tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Amar chakri chole gyache, ki korbo bujhte parchi na.
options: Kono byapar na, tumi notun kaj peye jabe.
Tumi ki tahole Kolkata chere jabe?
Ami kal theke notun kaj shuru korechi.
questions.correctAnswer: Kono byapar na, tumi notun kaj peye jabe.
questions.translatedSentence: It is all right, you will find a new job.

questions.sentence: Kendo na, amake sob khule bolo.
options: Do not cry, tell me everything.
Do not shout, listen to me first.
Do not go now, wait for me here.
questions.correctAnswer: Do not cry, tell me everything.

questions.sentence: Aajkal ami khub ekla bodh korchi.
options: Cholo, kal amra ekshathe ghurte jai.
Tahole tumi ekla thako.
Ami o tomar kotha bhabini.
questions.correctAnswer: Cholo, kal amra ekshathe ghurte jai.
questions.translatedSentence: Come on, let us go out together tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Tumi onek kichhu korecho, nijer upor bishwas rakho.
options: You have done a lot, believe in yourself.
You have worked a lot, take some rest now.
You have helped me a lot, thank you very much.
questions.correctAnswer: You have done a lot, believe in yourself.

questions.sentence: Ami baar baar bhul korchi, nijer upor raag hochche.
options: Sobai bhul kore, nijer upor raag koro na.
Ha, tumi sotti onek bhul koro.
Ami tomar kotha bujhte parchi na.
questions.correctAnswer: Sobai bhul kore, nijer upor raag koro na.
questions.translatedSentence: Everyone makes mistakes, do not be angry with yourself.

questions.sentence: Tomar ki macher jhol bhalo lage?
options: Ha, amar macher jhol khub bhalo lage.
Na, ami mach dhorte jai na.
Ha, ami ekhon rannaghore achi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, amar macher jhol khub bhalo lage.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I like fish curry very much.

questions.sentence: Amar bhalo lage na jokhon keu michhe kotha bole.
options: I do not like it when someone tells a lie.
I do not like it when someone arrives late.
I do not know when he will tell the truth.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not like it when someone tells a lie.

questions.sentence: Aaj sondhyay ki korte ichche korche?
options: Ganga r pare boshe cha khete ichche korche.
Kal sokale ami office giyechilam.
Amar tram e uthte bhoy kore na.
questions.correctAnswer: Ganga r pare boshe cha khete ichche korche.
questions.translatedSentence: I feel like sitting by the Ganga and having tea.

questions.sentence: Ami ekdin tram e chore sara Kolkata ghurte chai.
options: One day I want to ride the tram all around Kolkata.
One day I want to walk across the Howrah bridge.
Every day I take the tram to go around Kolkata.
questions.correctAnswer: One day I want to ride the tram all around Kolkata.

questions.sentence: Tomar ki metro te jete bhalo lage, na ki bus e?
options: Amar metro te jete beshi bhalo lage.
Ami roj hente office jai.
Amar bus e uthte deri hoye jay.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar metro te jete beshi bhalo lage.
questions.translatedSentence: I prefer travelling by metro.

questions.sentence: Amar mishti khub bhalo lage, kintu roj khai na.
options: I love sweets, but I do not eat them every day.
I love sweets, but I cannot make them at home.
I like tea very much, but I do not drink it every day.
questions.correctAnswer: I love sweets, but I do not eat them every day.

questions.sentence: Tomar emon kono ichche ache ja ekhono puron hoyni?
options: Ha, ami ekbar Darjeeling jete chai.
Ha, amar sob ichche puron hoye gyache.
Na, ami Darjeeling theke esechi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, ami ekbar Darjeeling jete chai.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I want to visit Darjeeling once.

questions.sentence: Amar dupurbelay ghumote khub bhalo lage.
options: I really enjoy sleeping in the afternoon.
I really enjoy walking in the afternoon.
I really do not like waking up early.
questions.correctAnswer: I really enjoy sleeping in the afternoon.

questions.sentence: Tumi cha bhalobasho na coffee?
options: Amar cha i beshi bhalo lage.
Ami dudh diye bhaat khai.
Ami coffee banate jani na.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar cha i beshi bhalo lage.
questions.translatedSentence: I like tea more.

questions.sentence: Amar mone hoy Kolkatar tram ekhon bondho kore dewa uchit.
options: Ami ekmot noi, karon tram amader shohorer oitijjho.
Ha, ami kal tram e uthechilam.
Amar tram e uthte bhalo lage na.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami ekmot noi, karon tram amader shohorer oitijjho.
questions.translatedSentence: I do not agree, because the tram is part of our city's heritage.

questions.sentence: Apni thik i bolchen, kintu amar ektu onno mot ache.
options: You are right, but I have a slightly different opinion.
You are right, and I completely agree with you.
You are wrong, but I do not want to argue about it.
questions.correctAnswer: You are right, but I have a slightly different opinion.

questions.sentence: Ami dukkhito, sedin apnar upor amar raag kora uchit hoyni.
options: Thik ache, ami kichhu mone korini.
Ha, apni sotti khub kharap bolechen.
Ami apnar sathe ar kotha bolbo na.
questions.correctAnswer: Thik ache, ami kichhu mone korini.
questions.translatedSentence: It is all right, I did not take it to heart.

questions.sentence: Kal deri kore asar jonno ami sotti khub dukkhito.
options: I am truly sorry for arriving late yesterday.
I am truly sorry that I could not come at all yesterday.
I am truly glad that you came early yesterday.
questions.correctAnswer: I am truly sorry for arriving late yesterday.

questions.sentence: Apnar ki mone hoy Howrah bridge e hente jawa nirapod?
options: Ha, tobe bhirer somoy ektu sabdhane jaben.
Na, ami Howrah station e kokhono jaini.
Ha, ami roj metro te office jai.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, tobe bhirer somoy ektu sabdhane jaben.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but please be careful when it is crowded.

questions.sentence: Ami rege giyechilam bole oi kotha bolechilam, amake khoma koro.
options: I said that because I was angry, please forgive me.
I said that because I was worried, please do not be angry.
I said nothing to you because I was angry with him.
questions.correctAnswer: I said that because I was angry, please forgive me.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki mone koro ami bhul korechi?
options: Bhul korecho thik i, kintu tumi sudhre nite paro.
Ha, ami tomar sathe kokhono ekmot noi.
Na, ami tomar kotha shunte pai ni.
questions.correctAnswer: Bhul korecho thik i, kintu tumi sudhre nite paro.
questions.translatedSentence: You did make a mistake, but you can still put it right.

questions.sentence: Jodi ami tomake kosto diye thaki, tahole ami sotti dukkhito.
options: If I have hurt you, then I am truly sorry.
If you are angry with me, then please tell me now.
If I had known this, then I would not have come here.
questions.correctAnswer: If I have hurt you, then I am truly sorry.

questions.sentence: Apni ki ei byapare amar sathe ekmot?
options: Onekta ekmot, tobe sob byapare noi.
Ha, ami apnake chinte parchi na.
Na, ami ekhono kichhu i shunini.
questions.correctAnswer: Onekta ekmot, tobe sob byapare noi.
questions.translatedSentence: I agree with much of it, though not on everything.
